title: Follicular Recoverability Knee is an intervention-response gain transition, not a static baldness threshold

definition.baseline_burden: z = prospectively declared degeneration/structural-state coordinate measured before intervention
definition.local_control_gain: g(z) = partial functional recovery / partial declared control input
definition.operational_knee: FRK candidate = interval with the steepest unique decline in g across increasing z

known_answers.reason: uniform linear gain loss has no unique knee under the frozen definition

required_evidence: baseline burden measured before the control input
declared intervention/control input with reference comparison
functional later output linked to the prediction unit
coverage across enough baseline-burden range to estimate gain change
donor/region hierarchy and attrition handled under HF-SIM-038/HF-SIM-039
observer and diagnostic-probe back-action controlled where applicable
stage_marker_boundary: Cross-sectional partial-bald vs complete-bald differences in CD34/Sox9 or structure may define useful sampling strata but do not themselves identify FRK because no intervention-response gain is measured.
non_equivalences: progenitor loss threshold != FRK without response data
one intervention's gain knee != universal treatment threshold
ex-vivo FRK != in-vivo clinical decision rule
next_test: After HF-VAL-006 establishes linked early-state/later-function prediction, stratify by prospectively measured baseline P/E/M burden and test whether intervention response gain declines smoothly or contains a reproducible donor-held-out transition region.
claim_boundary: FRK is currently an operational research target only. No human in-vivo recoverability knee has been demonstrated.
